title: Deploy App via Kustomize Production Overlay
prompt:
A production Kustomize overlay exists locally at `assets/kustomize/overlays/prod`.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Inspect `assets/kustomize/overlays/prod` and apply the Kustomize overlay into namespace `cka-kust`.
2. Ensure Deployment `web-app` reaches `2` ready replicas and Service `web-app` exposes healthy endpoints.
hints: Preview rendered manifests first using `kubectl kustomize assets/kustomize/overlays/prod`.
Apply directly into `cka-kust` with `k apply -n cka-kust -k assets/kustomize/overlays/prod`.

checks.description: Service `web-app` has at least 2 ready endpoints

reference_solution: Apply the Kustomize production overlay into namespace `cka-kust` with `kubectl apply -n cka-kust -k assets/kustomize/overlays/prod`.
